description: Canalisations des réseaux de chaleur et de froid de la Métropole de Lyon is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Métropole de Lyon. The district heating network is a centrally produced heat distribution system that carries overheated water through the city. It provides the energy needed for heating and domestic hot water for large urban areas, such as hospitals, schools, collective housing, office buildings, tertiary and industrial sites. Coverage: Métropole de Lyon. The portal shows the English title as "Pipelines of the district heating and cooling networks of the Metropolis of Lyon" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Métropole de Lyon. The listing shows 3 download or service links in SHP, GEOJSON, CSV. The listing shows 2026-06-24 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
